description: Contract v1.0 — the JSON body of a [JARVIS-RESULT] email sent by the bridge after a task runs.

acceptance_criteria.description: Each acceptance criterion with its pass/fail outcome.

attachments.description: Basenames of files actually attached to the result email.

exit_code.description: 0 = all acceptance criteria passed; anything else = failed or partial.

jarvis_report.description: Plain-language summary: what was done, what was not done and why.

task_id.description: Echoes the task email's task_id exactly.
